rationale: Y's top findings map directly onto the actual reviewer thread: the mtp-seed-under-full-cudagraphs issue (Y proposes moving the gating into the runner, exactly what gcanlin's follow-up TODO asked for) and the talker_mtp_graph_safe=True-on-NPU mismatch (which explains the real Wallbreazzz NPU crash mechanism far more precisely than X's generic 'CI is red' flag). X's seed-reproducibility finding is solid but shallower (adds a warning rather than diagnosing the root architectural mismatch), and its NPU/CI finding doesn't reach the actual crash cause. Both are well-grounded with specific file:line evidence and concrete, actionable suggested patches, but Y covers substantially more of the ground-truth concern set (architecture placement, seed handling, NPU safety, capacity-retune vs benchmark discussion) while X covers mainly the seed issue plus tangential test/comment nits.
